verdict.rationale: Sentry has a first-party docs page titled "Fingerprint Rules" under an event-grouping section. That points to a documented way to customize how events group into issues, and issue-state triage docs confirm events are handled as issues. The evidence is only a page title and URL, though: nothing describes how stack-trace grouping collapses duplicates or how rules override it. missing for 10: description of automatic stack-trace fingerprint grouping behavior, details of how fingerprint rules customize or override grouping, hands-on or independent corroboration.
